## app_setting

Canonical key/value/datatype simulation parameters for the template; loaded into AppSettings at startup. A key the code expects but does not find here makes from_map panic (fail-loud).

| Column | Type | Null | Key | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `app_setting_id` | INTEGER | NULL | PK1 |  |  |
| `key` | TEXT | NOT NULL |  |  |  |
| `value` | TEXT | NOT NULL |  |  |  |
| `datatype` | TEXT | NOT NULL |  | 'f64' |  |

## cell

Per-timestep state of every grid cell in the 3D volume: matter density, curvature, gravity vector, rip and dimple fields, plus black-hole, SMBH, star, galaxy, and lensing-candidate flags. The main spatial state table.

| Column | Type | Null | Key | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cell_id` | INTEGER | NULL | PK1 |  | Unique identifier for this cell in the database |
| `cell_position_id` | INTEGER | NOT NULL |  |  |  |
| `timestep` | usize | NOT NULL |  |  | Simulation timestep at which this cell state was recorded |
| `layer` | usize | NOT NULL |  |  | Z-layer index within the 3D grid |
| `curvature` | REAL | NOT NULL |  |  | Local curvature of spacetime at this cell |
| `matter_density` | REAL | NOT NULL |  |  | Mass density of matter within the cell |
| `is_black_hole` | BOOLEAN | NOT NULL |  |  | True if this cell has collapsed into a black hole |
| `rip_strength` | REAL | NOT NULL |  |  | Strength of the rip field in this cell |
| `black_hole_id` | u64 | NULL |  |  | legitimately NULL for non-BH cells |
| `scale_factor` | REAL | NOT NULL |  |  | Cosmological scale factor at this timestep |
| `gravity_x` | REAL | NOT NULL |  |  | X-component of the gravitational vector at this cell |
| `gravity_y` | REAL | NOT NULL |  |  | Y-component of the gravitational vector at this cell |
| `gravity_z` | REAL | NOT NULL |  |  | Z-component of the gravitational vector at this cell |
| `dimple_strength` | REAL | NOT NULL |  |  | Calculated per cell after inflation (can be negative) |
| `is_lensing_candidate` | BOOLEAN | NOT NULL |  | 0 | Ff strong dimple + low matter density |
| `is_supermassive` | BOOLEAN | NOT NULL |  | 0 | Is this cell is an SMBH (mass exceeds threshold) |
| `mass` | REAL | NOT NULL |  |  | Total mass in the cell |
| `smbh_rip_contribution` | BOOLEAN | NOT NULL |  |  | The amount this cell contributes to the dark energy rip field |
| `is_rip_induced` | BOOLEAN | NOT NULL |  | 0 | True if this black hole was created due to rip-induced collapse (not from natural matter collapse) |
| `run_id` | INTEGER | NOT NULL |  |  |  |
| `smbh_connection_strength` | REAL | NOT NULL |  |  | Per-SMBH parent-connection feed rate, assigned at formation from the heavy-tailed draw. Most SMBHs get a near-zero value (they stall); a rare few get a strong connection and run away to overmassive scale. Zero for non-SMBH cells. |
| `is_star` | BOOLEAN | NOT NULL |  | 0 | True if this cell contains a star. |
| `galaxy_id` | INT | NOT NULL |  | 0 | ID of the galaxy this cell belongs to. |
| `rip_dimple` | REAL | NOT NULL |  | 0 | The amount this cell's dimple contributes to the overall gravity, calculated after inflation. |
| `volume` | REAL | NOT NULL |  | 1.0 | Physical volume of the cell in simulated space |

## cell_position

Fixed (col, row) grid coordinate a cell_position_id maps to; the per-timestep state and the layer live on the cell row. Decouples position from state so positions are stored once.

| Column | Type | Null | Key | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cell_position_id` | INTEGER | NULL | PK1 |  |  |
| `col` | usize | NOT NULL |  |  |  |
| `row` | usize | NOT NULL |  |  |  |

## custom_density

Optional hand-seeded initial density overrides at specific (col, row, layer) coordinates, for setting up bespoke initial conditions instead of procedural noise.

| `col` | INTEGER | NOT NULL | PK1 |  |  |
| `row` | INTEGER | NOT NULL | PK2 |  |  |
| `layer` | INTEGER | NOT NULL | PK3 |  |  |
| `density` | REAL | NOT NULL |  |  |  |
